notes: Extra helpers beyond spec: centred_gram, soft_threshold, cd_sweep, enet_cd_gram, group_bootstrap_rows, average_ranks. Caveat: on an ill-conditioned design (cond ~2e4, mixed random columns) with alpha=1e-3 and rho<=0.5, enet_cd needs 6000-9000 sweeps, so the 5000 default max_sweeps stops early (dw 4e-3 vs sklearn); with max_sweeps=200000 dw < 1e-6. Phase 4 callers should check the sweeps count against max_sweeps. Oracle script lives outside the repo.
